newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM to sell uranium stakes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM to sell uranium stakes.

text.p: Sedimentary Mining NL said on Friday that one of its units would be funded by Southern Cross Resources Inc of Toronto to buy MIM Holdings Ltd's stake in several South Australian uranium projects.
"Southern Cross will fund the purchase by Sedimentary of MIM Holdings Ltd's uranium interest in the Honeymoon Project, Goulds Dam and EL1763 in South Australia," Sedimentary said.
Sedimentary subsidiary Chatfield Energy Development Pty Ltd would hold the stake, but Chatfield would be bought by Southern Cross from Sedimentary in exchange for shares in Southern Cross.
"The resulting structure will see the future development of the Honeymoon project managed and financed by Southern Cross/Chatfield," Sedimentary said.
"Sedimentary will concentrate its efforts on its gold projects whilst retaining an equity stake in Southern Cross/Chatfield," it said.
Southern Cross would raise additional funds to develop Honeymoon, EL1763 and Goulds Dam and would in due course be listed on a Canadian Stock Exchange, Sedimentary said.
